description: Hourly Chicago weather forecast (blend model, method labeled). Hourly weather forecast for Chicago: temperature, precipitation probability, and wind, up to 168 hours out. NWS-derived series, bias-blended with our calibrated station model where covered — every response labels the method that produced it. Same shape as /v1/forecast/point with the Chicago coordinates built in. [HTTP: GET /v1/forecast/chicago · price dynamic ($0.01 for hours ≤ 48, $0.03 beyond) via x402 · docs https://x402-factory.com/docs/weather.forecast.chicago]
